Name: T's Apartment House
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=5]Give each of your spouses their own room with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]"![/size][/color][/center]

[color=#00ffff][size=5]This mod adds a spacious apartment-style farmhouse with private rooms for multiple spouses![/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=3](You can also use this mod without multiple spouses or PolyamorySweet.
It works perfectly well as a spacious farmhouse with lots of rooms.)[/size][/color]
(Probably not compatible with multiplayer.)

[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043][color=#ff7700]T's Core[/color][/url][color=#ffff00] v1.9.1 or later is required.[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Using PolyamorySweet?[/size][/color]
If you use the optional PSR Content Pack included on this mod's Files page, you can assign rooms to multiple spouses directly in-game through GMCM.
There is no need to edit the JSON file manually.

The farmhouse map includes various small improvements and adjustments.
You can also use the Mod Config settings to add partitions and customize the floors and walls in much more detail than in the vanilla farmhouse.
[color=#00ff00][size=4]Customize the apartment and make it a home for you and your spouses![/size][/color]

Changes to the farmhouse map will be applied starting from the second farmhouse upgrade.

Due to how PSR works, a flooring tile is placed one tile below each spouse room. Normally, placing flooring on one of these tiles changes all of them at the same time.
Since this looks unnatural with this mod's layout, an extra tile is displayed between each spouse room and the hallway as part of the black ceiling area.


If a custom NPC is your spouse, furniture placement may sometimes block them from entering their room.
If you encounter this issue, please make a compatibility request.
I will try to add compatibility where possible!
